name: wake-surfer
description: Video conferencing and realtime collaboration platform.

scripts.build:realtime-chat: pnpm --filter @wake-surfer/realtime-chat-api build && pnpm --filter @wake-surfer/realtime-chat-gateway build && pnpm --filter @wake-surfer/realtime-chat-stream-messages-client build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.dev:realtime-chat: pnpm docker:up && pnpm build:realtime-chat && node scripts/run-realtime-chat-dev.mjs
scripts.db:validate:realtime-chat: docker compose run --rm --build --no-deps realtime-chat-migrate migrate validate --dir file:///workspace/migrations
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d realtime-chat-postgres realtime-chat-redis && docker compose run --rm --build realtime-chat-migrate
